name: Doglands
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 1.00). Replaced keyword guess "bridge-crosschain".
rootCause: Dogechain ecological multi-purpose GameFi and DeFi agreement Doglands may have exit scams. The contract addresses on the project chain are 0x106E6a2D5433247441c1Cdf4E3e24a0696a46d0, 0x12b17 and 0x0e815, which drain all the reserves in the LP tokens, with a value of about $204000. The funds have now been transferred to Ethereum through the cross-chain bridge and transferred to multiple addresses. Doglands has deleted the official Twitter and website.
